guide.title: OPC Hub user guide
guide.sub: Steps to get started with the one person company community.

register.title: 1. Sign up for an account
register.body: Click Sign up, choose Individual or Business, fill in your details, then select your role and the province/city groups you want to join.

otp.title: 2. Verify your email with OTP
otp.body: Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to your email (valid for 10 minutes) to activate your account.

fee.title: 3. Pay the membership fee
fee.body: Transfer 600.000đ/year using the exact reference shown on the payment screen. The system reconciles automatically and activates your 12-month membership card.

use.title: 4. Get started
use.body: Join Community, Group chat, Events, OPC projects, Investment interest and Service consultation requests.

renew.title: 5. Renew
renew.body: When your card has 30 days or less remaining, you will receive a renewal reminder. Early renewals are added on to your current expiry date.

guide.supportBody: Need help? Email the administrators via the Contact link on the sign-in page.
